analysis.exam_tip: 对照 supplementary 与 core 两个定位。

audio.transcript: The speaker argued that digital literacy, critical thinking, and collaborative problem-solving are not merely supplementary skills but core competencies that every graduate must possess in the modern economy.

card_records.back_text: 说话人把它们定位为核心能力，而非仅仅是补充技能。

analysis.exam_tip: 听三次 it 后各接什么好处。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 第一种电池 lighter，更轻；第二种 heavier，但续航 almost twice as long，接近两倍。选哪种取决于更在意便携性，还是更久不用充电。

card_records.back_text: 第一种更轻便，第二种更重但续航接近两倍。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 两组书面说明和可用时间相同，区别是其中一组还看了演示。演示组结果 more accurate，更准确；did not work faster 表明速度没有提高。
analysis.exam_tip: 记共同条件，再记演示带来的准确率变化。

Their results were more accurate, although they did not work faster. The comparison concerns the added demonstration, rather than a difference in time or written guidance.

card_records.back_text: 时间和书面说明相同；差别是是否先看演示，演示组更准确但未更快。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: less noise 表示噪声比旧型号小，并不是无声。在嘈杂车间可能不易察觉，在安静房间仍能听见，所以要在类似实际工作的环境中比较。
analysis.exam_tip: 对照 busy workshop 与 quiet room。

audio.transcript: The new machine produces less noise than the previous model, but it is not silent. In a busy workshop the remaining sound may be difficult to notice, whereas in a quiet room it would still be audible. Users should compare it under conditions similar to those in which they will actually work.

card_records.back_text: 比旧型号更安静，但仍有可听见的声音，感受随环境而变。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 安装新系统比修旧系统贵，这是当前费用。is expected to 表示预计：以后换件和维护会少一些，因此可能节省后续开支，尚不是已发生的节省。
analysis.exam_tip: 分别记“现在安装更贵”和“以后可能省维护费”。

audio.transcript: Installing the new system costs more than repairing the old one. Over time, however, it is expected to require fewer replacement parts and less routine maintenance. The report therefore distinguishes the immediate expense from possible savings later, rather than claiming that the new option is cheaper from the very beginning.

card_records.back_text: 安装费用较高，后续预计维护和换件需求较低。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 社区分馆空间少，重点是日常借阅、儿童活动和本地信息服务。稀有研究资料主要去中心馆找；两者在资源和服务上有分工。
analysis.exam_tip: 用“日常服务／专业资料”区分两馆。

audio.transcript: Unlike the large central library, the neighbourhood branch has little space for specialist collections. It focuses instead on everyday borrowing, children's activities and help with local information. Visitors who need rare research materials are directed to the central library, while routine services remain close to where residents live.

card_records.back_text: 社区分馆侧重日常服务，专业稀有研究资料主要由中心馆提供。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 市中心路线距离短，但高峰期红绿灯和拥堵可能让它更慢。外环路长几公里，却可能更早到；非高峰时，这个时间优势可能消失。
analysis.exam_tip: 分开记距离和高峰耗时。

audio.transcript: The route through the town centre is shorter in distance. However, traffic lights and heavy congestion often make it slower during the rush hour. The outer route is several kilometres longer, but drivers may arrive sooner because it avoids the busiest junctions. Outside peak times, that advantage may disappear.

card_records.back_text: 市中心路线距离更短，外环路线高峰时可能更快。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: compared with three days last year 把现在和去年比较：过去大多需三天，现在多数咨询一天内回复。比较对象是同一家公司不同时期的表现。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 compared with 后给出的时间基准。

audio.transcript: The company now responds to most enquiries within a day, compared with three days last year. The improvement followed changes to the support rota, though the number of staff stayed the same. This is a comparison with its earlier performance; the report does not provide figures for competing firms.

card_records.back_text: 比较同一家公司去年与现在的响应时间。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 逻辑关系

front.context: 听录音：两个小组是否面临完全相同的问题？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 两组都迟交，但第一组在等设备，第二组没有商定谁写最后一部分。原因不同，一个要解决设备使用问题，另一个要明确分工。
analysis.exam_tip: 给两组分别记原因，不只记共同结果“迟交”。

audio.transcript: Both groups submitted their work late, but for different reasons. The first was waiting for access to equipment; the second had received all its materials but had not agreed on who would write the final section. A common outcome therefore does not mean that the same solution would help both teams.

card_records.back_text: 不是。一个缺设备使用机会，另一个分工未定，解决办法应不同。

front.context: 听录音：研究者在哪个指标上认为两种方法相近？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: as effective as 表示效果相当，但这里仅指帮助参与者完成眼前的基础任务。高级应用和几个月后的表现没有测试，因此不能据此判断长期效果也相同。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 in helping 后限定了哪一项效果。

audio.transcript: In this trial, the shorter training session was as effective as the longer one in helping participants complete the basic task. The researchers did not test advanced applications or performance several months later. Their comparison is therefore limited to the immediate task, not to every possible benefit of training.

card_records.back_text: 在完成当下基础任务这一指标上相近。

front.context: 听录音：讲者是否要求所有人都选夜间课程？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 夜课更适合白天工作的人；早课可能适合早晨注意力更好的人。建议先看自己的安排和课程时间表，再作选择。
analysis.exam_tip: 分别记晚课和早课适合谁。

audio.transcript: Evening classes offer greater flexibility for people who work during the day. Morning classes, on the other hand, may suit those who concentrate better earlier. The adviser recommends checking personal commitments and the course timetable, rather than assuming that one schedule will be preferable for every student.

card_records.back_text: 没有。两种时段适合不同需要，应结合个人安排选择。

front.prompt: 听录音：A组的通过率更高，是否意味着通过人数更多？

front.context: 听录音：A组的通过率更高，是否意味着通过人数更多？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: A 组共 20 人，通过率 90%，通过 18 人；B 组共 50 人，通过率 80%，通过 40 人。B 虽比例较低，通过人数却更多，因为总人数更大。
analysis.exam_tip: 用“总人数 × 通过率”算通过人数。

audio.transcript: Group A had a higher pass rate, at ninety percent, but included only twenty people. Group B had a lower rate of eighty percent and included fifty. As a result, more people passed in Group B, despite its lower percentage. The two measures answer different questions.

card_records.back_text: 不意味着。A通过18人，B通过40人，B人数更多。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 逻辑关系
front.prompt: 听录音：两项数据相反变化是否已被证明互为原因？

front.context: 听录音：两项数据相反变化是否已被证明互为原因？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 数字目录使用量增加，帮助台咨询量下降。报告只说两种趋势相反，没有证实因果；同时开放时间和排班也变了，可能影响结果。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 does not establish 后排除了哪种结论。

audio.transcript: Use of the digital catalogue increased, while requests at the help desk declined. The report presents these contrasting trends but does not establish that one caused the other. Opening hours and staffing arrangements also changed during the period, so the authors advise against drawing a simple causal conclusion.

card_records.back_text: 没有。报告只展示相反趋势，同时还有其他变化。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 逻辑关系

front.context: 听录音：研究者什么时候可以带走样本？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: provided that 后要求目标实验室有获批的存储设施；must also 再加一项：离开前登记转移。两项都满足，才可把样本带离现场。
analysis.exam_tip: 记“合格存储设施＋离开前登记”。

audio.transcript: Researchers may take the samples off site, provided that the destination laboratory has approved storage facilities. They must also record the transfer before leaving. Permission to enter the building does not by itself authorise the removal of materials, so both requirements should be checked in advance.

card_records.back_text: 目标实验室有合格存储设施，并在离开前登记转移。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: unless the wind reaches an unsafe level 是照常举行的例外条件。雨天还有遮蔽区域可用，最终决定会在活动当天早上公布。
analysis.exam_tip: 区分不安全的大风与单纯下雨。

audio.transcript: The outdoor activity will go ahead unless the wind reaches an unsafe level. Rain alone will not automatically lead to cancellation, as covered areas are available. The final decision will be announced on the morning of the event after staff review the local conditions.

card_records.back_text: 风力达到不安全程度；仅下雨不会自动取消活动。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: Only applicants who complete... 表示完成培训才有资格被考虑。does not guarantee an offer 说明这还不保证录用，因为评审还要看相关经验和空缺数量。
analysis.exam_tip: 记“培训完成 → 可被考虑”，不是“必获录用”。

audio.transcript: Only applicants who complete the introductory training can be considered for the position. However, completing it does not guarantee an offer, because the panel must also assess relevant experience and the number of vacancies. The training is a requirement for consideration, not a promise of employment.

card_records.back_text: 不保证。培训是被考虑的必要条件，还需评估经验和空缺。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 预约要同时满足收到付款和确认有名额。and 连接两项要求；若已满员，会退款，或经申请人同意转到其他日期。
analysis.exam_tip: 付款和确认名额，各记一项。

audio.transcript: The reservation becomes valid when payment has been received and the organiser has confirmed that a place is available. Paying alone is not sufficient. If the session is already full, the payment will be returned or moved to another date with the applicant's agreement.

card_records.back_text: 收到付款且确认有名额，两项都满足才生效。

analysis.title: 解析

analysis.exam_tip: 把“有人监督”当作整个使用期间都要满足的条件。

If the supervisor has to leave, practical work must stop until another qualified person arrives. The building may remain open, but that does not remove the requirement for supervised use of the equipment.

card_records.back_text: 必须有受过训练的监督人员在场，离开后需停下实践操作。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: at least forty-eight hours 表示至少提前 48 小时。计时依据是办公室 receives the request，即收到取消请求；参与者自己决定不来的时间不算。

analysis.exam_tip: 记比较结果，同时保留一周后、实验室内这两个条件。

audio.transcript: In a small laboratory study, one group of mice learned a route with several landmarks. Another group used a route without them. After a week, the first group made fewer wrong turns, although the study did not test performance outside the laboratory.

card_records.back_text: 有地标组一周后走错的次数更少；没有测试实验室之外的表现。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 移除熟悉地标后，两组差距变小。研究者据此 suggested，提出一种解释：老鼠 partly relied on landmarks，部分依靠地标辨路。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 much smaller 的差距，再听 partly 限定依赖程度。

audio.transcript: The researchers repeated the task after removing the familiar landmarks. The difference between the two groups became much smaller. They suggested that the mice had relied partly on those landmarks rather than learning the route independently of their surroundings.

card_records.back_text: 两组差距缩小，研究者认为表现部分依赖地标，而非完全脱离环境记住路线。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 听录音，调查为什么不能直接证明学习小组让学生更自信？

front.context: 听录音，调查为什么不能直接证明学习小组让学生更自信？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 参加学习小组的人报告更自信，但学生并非随机分组。可能是原本更自信的人更愿意参加，因此无法只把差异归因于学习小组。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 already confident，注意自信也可能早于入组。

audio.transcript: A survey found that students who joined regular study groups reported greater confidence. However, the researchers did not assign students to groups at random. Students who were already confident may simply have been more willing to join.

card_records.back_text: 不能直接证明。原本更自信的学生可能更愿意参加。

front.prompt: 听录音，两班复习总时间相同，哪班一周后记得更多？这项比较有什么限制？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 分四天复习的班比一次集中复习的班记得更多。两班没有随机分配，所以他们原先的差异也可能影响结果，不能只凭这次比较确定是安排方式造成的。
analysis.exam_tip: 先比复习方式，再听 had not been randomly assigned。

audio.transcript: Two classes used different revision schedules. One studied for a single long session, while the other spread the same total time across four days. A week later, the second class remembered more, but the classes had not been randomly assigned.

card_records.back_text: 分四天复习的班一周后记住更多；两班没有随机分配。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉

front.context: 听录音，在广泛推荐这种方法前，研究团队还要研究哪些人？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 当前改善出现在少量 experienced users，有经验的用户身上。团队还想在 beginners 和 different age groups 中重复研究，即初学者和不同年龄组。
analysis.exam_tip: 对照当前 experienced users 与接下来两类人群。

audio.transcript: The research team observed improved performance in a small group of experienced users. Before recommending the method more widely, they want to repeat the study with beginners and with people from different age groups.

card_records.back_text: 还要在初学者和不同年龄组中重复研究。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 听录音，三项试验有哪些共同发现？为什么还要进一步测试？
front.support: 听录音，三项试验有哪些共同发现？为什么还要进一步测试？
front.context: 听录音，三项试验有哪些共同发现？为什么还要进一步测试？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 三项试验都发现清楚说明与较少错误有关。但差异幅度不一，其中一项样本很小，所以团队用 promising 表示有希望，仍要求进一步测试。
analysis.exam_tip: 把共同趋势、差异大小和小样本分别记下。

audio.transcript: Across the three trials, clear instructions were linked to fewer errors. The size of the difference varied, and one trial had only a small sample. The team described the pattern as promising while calling for further testing.

card_records.back_text: 清楚说明与较少错误相关，但差异大小不同，且一项试验样本较小；还需进一步测试。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 听录音：教学顾问怎样看待课程录播？
front.support: 听录音：教学顾问怎样看待课程录播？
front.context: 听录音：教学顾问怎样看待课程录播？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 顾问支持录播，因为学生可以重看难点。但她强调还要保留讨论、提问和应用练习；单有视频不够，学生也需要互动。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 supports 的理由，再听 only when 的条件。

audio.transcript: The teaching adviser supports recording large lectures because students can return to difficult explanations. However, she warns that recordings should not become a reason to remove opportunities for discussion. In her view, access to a video is useful only when students also have a way to ask questions and practise applying the ideas.

card_records.back_text: 支持大型讲座录播，但认为还须保留讨论、提问和应用机会。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 听录音：规划专家对未来需求作出了什么判断？
front.support: 听录音：规划专家对未来需求作出了什么判断？
front.context: 听录音：规划专家对未来需求作出了什么判断？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 如果更多课程晚下课，顾问预计晚间公交需求会上升。不过现有数据太少，不足以支持立刻加倍班次；她建议再收集一学期数据，逐步调整。
analysis.exam_tip: 分开记“预计需求增长”和“建议先补数据”。

audio.transcript: The transport planner expects demand for evening buses to grow if more classes finish late. But she says the available figures are too limited to justify doubling the service immediately. She recommends collecting another term of data and adjusting the timetable gradually, rather than treating the forecast as a guaranteed outcome.

card_records.back_text: 若晚课增加，晚间公交需求可能上升，但应继续收集数据、逐步调整。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 听录音：档案管理专家建议先做什么，再考虑扩充什么？
front.support: 听录音：档案管理专家建议先做什么，再考虑扩充什么？
front.context: 听录音：档案管理专家建议先做什么，再考虑扩充什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 先查哪些文件重复、哪些必须保留，并弄清归属和保留期限。规则明确后，才估计还需多少存储空间；仅买容量解决不了文件管理混乱。
analysis.exam_tip: 按 Before 与 Once 记“先理文件，再算空间”。

audio.transcript: Before buying more storage space, the records specialist recommends checking which files are duplicated and which must be retained. She points out that extra capacity will not solve confusion about ownership or retention periods. Once those rules are clear, the organisation can estimate how much additional storage it actually needs.

card_records.back_text: 先查重复文件和保留规则，再估计额外存储需求。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 听录音：统计顾问为什么反对只比较两个平均数？
front.support: 听录音：统计顾问为什么反对只比较两个平均数？
front.context: 听录音：统计顾问为什么反对只比较两个平均数？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 顾问认为平均数差异值得研究，但应同时看数据分布。individual results overlap 表示两组个体结果有重叠，所以不能仅凭均值给每个人排出绝对高低。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 averages 与 individual results 的区别。

audio.transcript: The statistical adviser says the difference between the two averages is worth examining, but it should not be interpreted on its own. The groups vary in size, and individual results overlap substantially. She recommends looking at the spread of the data before claiming that every member of one group performs better than every member of the other.

card_records.back_text: 两组规模不同，个人结果也有大量重叠；平均数的差异不能说明一组每个人都比另一组所有人好。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 听录音：写作顾问为什么认为自动检查不能替代全部反馈？
front.support: 听录音：写作顾问为什么认为自动检查不能替代全部反馈？
front.context: 听录音：写作顾问为什么认为自动检查不能替代全部反馈？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 自动检查能发现重复词和部分拼写错误，但未必理解作者想说什么，也未必能判断例子是否支持论点。因此应先用工具检查，再细读和讨论。
analysis.exam_tip: 记工具擅长的表面问题，再记需要人理解的论证问题。

audio.transcript: The writing adviser finds automatic checks useful for spotting repeated words and some spelling errors. Yet she argues that a tool may not understand what a student intends to say or whether an example supports the argument. She therefore recommends using the checks as a first step, followed by careful reading and discussion.

card_records.back_text: 工具能查部分表面问题，却未必理解意图和论据关系，仍需阅读与讨论。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 听录音：专家提出的方案已经被正式采纳了吗？
front.support: 听录音：专家提出的方案已经被正式采纳了吗？
front.context: 听录音：专家提出的方案已经被正式采纳了吗？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 顾问建议把接待台移近无台阶入口，但学校尚未批准，因为还需电气施工。下周将讨论先设临时接待台；永久改造仍在评估。
analysis.exam_tip: 分别记“永久改造待批”和“临时桌台待讨论”。

audio.transcript: The accessibility consultant has recommended moving the main reception desk closer to the step-free entrance. The university has not yet approved the change, because electrical work would also be needed. The consultant will discuss a temporary desk with staff next week so that visitors can receive help while the permanent proposal is assessed.

card_records.back_text: 尚未正式批准；专家还将讨论临时咨询台方案。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 播放录音后，专家认为增设线路之外还应重视什么？
front.support: 播放录音后，专家认为增设线路之外还应重视什么？
front.context: 播放录音后，专家认为增设线路之外还应重视什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: if passengers cannot rely on the timetable 表示如果班次不可靠，增设线路的价值就有限。alongside 要求扩大覆盖与提高可靠性一起做。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 alongside 两边要并行改善的内容。

audio.transcript: An urban planner argues that adding bus routes will have limited value if passengers cannot rely on the timetable. She recommends improving service reliability alongside network coverage, rather than treating the number of routes as the only measure of success.

card_records.back_text: 重视班次可靠性，不能只按线路数量衡量成功。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 播放录音后，专家为什么不建议只看应用使用时长？
front.support: 播放录音后，专家为什么不建议只看应用使用时长？
front.context: 播放录音后，专家为什么不建议只看应用使用时长？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 使用时长只能说明用了多久，不能充分说明是否理解。研究者建议检查学生能否 explain or apply，即解释或运用材料中的知识。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 checking 后要求观察的两种行为。

audio.transcript: An education researcher warns that time spent on a learning app is not enough to show whether students have understood the material. She suggests checking what students can explain or apply after using it.

card_records.back_text: 时长不能充分说明理解程度，还应检查能否解释或运用所学。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 播放录音后，专家用长短路线的比较强调什么？
front.support: 播放录音后，专家用长短路线的比较强调什么？
front.context: 播放录音后，专家用长短路线的比较强调什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 短路线若连接住宅和车站，可能比远离日常服务的长路线更有用。比较的关键是是否通向居民真正需要去的地方，不只是增加了多少公里。
analysis.exam_tip: 找 short route 后连接的两个目的地。

audio.transcript: A transport engineer says that a new cycle lane should connect useful destinations, not simply add distance to the network. A short route linking homes to a station may serve residents better than a longer route that ends far from everyday services.

card_records.back_text: 路线应连接日常需要到达的地点，长度不是唯一价值指标。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 播放录音后，专家认为数字化还需要哪些配套？
front.support: 播放录音后，专家认为数字化还需要哪些配套？
front.context: 播放录音后，专家认为数字化还需要哪些配套？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 数字资料即使全已上线，如果说明不清、搜索不好用，仍难查找。图书馆员因此要求 clear descriptions 和 a reliable search system，清楚说明与可靠检索。
analysis.exam_tip: 把“文件上线”和“能找到、能使用”区分开。

audio.transcript: A librarian argues that opening a digital collection does not automatically make it accessible. Visitors still need clear descriptions and a reliable search system. Without these, a large archive may remain difficult to use even when every file is online.

card_records.back_text: 清楚的资料说明和可靠的检索系统。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 播放录音后，专家提醒听众避免怎样判断信息？
front.support: 播放录音后，专家提醒听众避免怎样判断信息？
front.context: 播放录音后，专家提醒听众避免怎样判断信息？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: a confident presentation 可能让证据薄弱的说法听起来可信。研究者建议检查 evidence and its source，即证据及其来源，不能只看说话人多自信。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 rather than 前建议采取的判断方法。

audio.transcript: A researcher studying online information cautions that a confident presentation can make a weak claim seem convincing. She advises readers to check the evidence and its source, rather than judging a statement only by how certain the speaker sounds.

card_records.back_text: 避免只凭表达自信就认定论点可靠，应核对证据和来源。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 细节捕捉
front.prompt: 播放录音后，专家建议如何试行新安排，为什么要收集两类信息？
front.support: 播放录音后，专家建议如何试行新安排，为什么要收集两类信息？
front.context: 播放录音后，专家建议如何试行新安排，为什么要收集两类信息？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: before applying it across the organisation 表示先小范围试行再决定推广。both...and... 要收集两类信息：员工反馈与服务质量，兼顾员工和客户的体验。
analysis.exam_tip: 题目问两类信息，就把 staff feedback 与 service quality 都记下。

audio.transcript: A workplace consultant recommends testing a new schedule with one team before applying it across the organisation. The trial should collect both staff feedback and information about service quality, since an arrangement that suits employees may still create problems for customers.

card_records.back_text: 先在一支团队试行，同时看员工反馈和服务质量，因为员工满意的安排也可能给客户带来问题。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：说话人主要希望对方做什么？
front.support: 听录音：说话人主要希望对方做什么？
front.context: 听录音：说话人主要希望对方做什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 开头肯定草稿的想法和引言，但推荐收录前还有要求：核对两项数字主张的来源。Could you... 明确请求补上引用，并在明天发修订稿。
analysis.exam_tip: 抓住 Could you 后的两个动作：add、send。

audio.transcript: There are several strong ideas in your draft, and the introduction is much clearer now. Before I can recommend it for the exhibition booklet, though, I need you to check the sources behind the two numerical claims. Could you add those references and send me a revised copy tomorrow?

card_records.back_text: 核对两项数字主张的来源，补上引用并提交修订稿。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：说话人是在答应今天见面，还是提出替代安排？

front.context: 听录音：说话人是在答应今天见面，还是提出替代安排？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: would like表达意愿，但cannot...this afternoon限制当前安排。tomorrow morning与send tonight是替代计划，不是取消讨论。
analysis.exam_tip: 区分愿意做某事与是否答应在当前时间做。

audio.transcript: I would like to discuss the project, but I cannot give it proper attention this afternoon because the deadline for another report is approaching. Would tomorrow morning work for you? If you send the outline tonight, I can read it before we meet and make the conversation more useful.

card_records.back_text: 婉拒今天下午，建议明天上午见面，并请对方今晚先发提纲。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：说话人提到学生做饭的例子，主要想说明什么？
front.support: 听录音：说话人提到学生做饭的例子，主要想说明什么？
front.context: 听录音：说话人提到学生做饭的例子，主要想说明什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 做饭例子中，学生会照步骤做，却在缺一种食材时不会调整。说话人用它说明：实验学习也要理解每步为什么这样做，才能应对变化。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 the same distinction applies to...，找到例子要说明的领域。

audio.transcript: Think of a student who can follow a recipe perfectly but becomes unsure when one ingredient is missing. Knowing the steps is useful, but understanding why each step matters makes adaptation possible. I mention this because the same distinction applies to laboratory work: a procedure should not be learned as an unexplained sequence of actions.

card_records.back_text: 说明理解步骤原理有助于应对变化，而不只是机械记住操作。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：结尾的问题主要起什么作用？
front.support: 听录音：结尾的问题主要起什么作用？
front.context: 听录音：结尾的问题主要起什么作用？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 前面提出数量增加仍有困难，并转向组织方式。反问不是询问具体页面数，而是质疑既有解决方向。
analysis.exam_tip: 结合前文判断问题是在求事实，还是在挑战一种做法。

audio.transcript: We have doubled the number of online resources, yet students still report difficulty finding the right material. Perhaps the issue is not how much information we provide but how clearly we organise it. If adding more pages has not solved the problem, should our next step really be to add even more?

card_records.back_text: 引导听众重新考虑继续增加资源是否能解决查找困难。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：说话人主要建议主办方如何改进？
front.support: 听录音：说话人主要建议主办方如何改进？
front.context: 听录音：说话人主要建议主办方如何改进？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: It might be worth trying... 是委婉建议。that format 指前句的每场报告后留一小段讨论时间，这样提前离开的人也有机会提问。
analysis.exam_tip: 回到 that format 前一句，找被建议采用的安排。

audio.transcript: The speakers were well prepared, and the topics attracted considerable interest. Still, several participants had to leave before they could ask questions. Other events reserve a short discussion period after each talk. It might be worth trying that format next time, instead of saving every question until the end of the day.

card_records.back_text: 考虑在每场报告后安排简短问答，不把所有问题留到一天结束。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：说话人说 I'm not suggesting... 的主要目的是什么？
front.support: 听录音：说话人说 I'm not suggesting... 的主要目的是什么？
front.context: 听录音：说话人说 I'm not suggesting... 的主要目的是什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: I’m not suggesting... 先说明不是要求放弃项目。My concern 才说真正担心的事：试点还未评估，就承诺效果；他希望继续研究时把收益说得谨慎些。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 My concern 后到底担心什么。

audio.transcript: I'm not suggesting that the project should be abandoned. My concern is that we are promising results before the pilot has been evaluated. We can continue the work while describing its benefits more cautiously. That would allow us to learn from the trial without giving participants expectations we may be unable to meet.

card_records.back_text: 澄清自己不是要求放弃项目，而是希望对预期效果更谨慎。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 播放录音后，说话人为什么建议询问恢复时间？
front.support: 播放录音后，说话人为什么建议询问恢复时间？
front.context: 播放录音后，说话人为什么建议询问恢复时间？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 比赛分数只反映赛果，未必反映球员承受多大负担。询问恢复用了多久，可以了解 how demanding the match was，即比赛对球员有多吃力。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 how demanding，找询问恢复时间的目的。

audio.transcript: After every match, we ask players how they felt. I also want us to ask how long it took them to recover. If we look only at the score, we may miss how demanding the match was for the people who played it.

card_records.back_text: 希望在比分之外了解比赛对球员造成的负担。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 播放录音后，说话人为什么举工厂旧址的例子？
front.support: 播放录音后，说话人为什么举工厂旧址的例子？
front.context: 播放录音后，说话人为什么举工厂旧址的例子？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 原工厂所在地现在有学院和公共花园，是城镇变化的具体例子。说话人想说明，比较具体街道比凭整体印象更容易发现变化。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 I mention...because 后直接说明的举例目的。

audio.transcript: People sometimes say our town never changes. Walk past the old factory, though, and you will now find a college and a public garden. I mention these places because change is easier to notice when we compare specific streets, not just our general impression.

card_records.back_text: 用具体街区变化回应“城镇从不改变”的印象。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 播放录音后，说话人想澄清哪项要求？
front.support: 播放录音后，说话人想澄清哪项要求？
front.context: 播放录音后，说话人想澄清哪项要求？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: I do not mean... 排除逐项背诵细节。后面三个要求才是讨论准备：读主要论点、记一个问题、准备解释它为什么重要。
analysis.exam_tip: 按 Read、note、be ready to explain 记三项要求。

audio.transcript: When I ask you to prepare for the discussion, I do not mean memorising every detail. Read the main argument, note one question, and be ready to explain why it matters. That will give us a better starting point than a list of facts alone.

card_records.back_text: 准备讨论不是背下每个细节，而是理解论点、提出问题并说明其重要性。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 播放录音后，说话人举经验丰富的志愿者提问，是想鼓励什么？
front.support: 播放录音后，说话人举经验丰富的志愿者提问，是想鼓励什么？
front.context: 播放录音后，说话人举经验丰富的志愿者提问，是想鼓励什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 最有经验的志愿者也会向别人询问新系统，说明经验不等于知道所有陌生流程。说话人用这个例子消除听众顾虑，鼓励主动提问。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 I mention this because 后的 worried about asking questions。

audio.transcript: I noticed that the most experienced volunteer asked for help with the new booking system. I mention this because some of you seem worried about asking questions. Experience does not mean already knowing every unfamiliar procedure.

card_records.back_text: 鼓励遇到新流程时主动提问，不必因有经验而认为不能求助。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 播放录音后，说话人要求的是哪一种行动？
front.support: 播放录音后，说话人要求的是哪一种行动？
front.context: 播放录音后，说话人要求的是哪一种行动？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 说话人担心一直等到完全确定就无法发现问题，因此请求先做 limited test，小范围测试。测试还要有明确的停止或调整办法，不是立即无限制投入。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 limited test 后必须配备的 stop or adjust。

audio.transcript: We cannot know every detail before beginning a small trial. If we wait for complete certainty, we may never discover what needs to change. I am asking for a limited test with clear ways to stop or adjust it, not an unrestricted commitment.

card_records.back_text: 开展范围有限、可以停止或调整的试验。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 播放录音后，说话人的教学目的是什么？
front.support: 播放录音后，说话人的教学目的是什么？
front.context: 播放录音后，说话人的教学目的是什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 说话人将示范怎样比较两份报告，但让学习者自己根据证据下结论。还要求说明推理，并在其他解释更合适时修改观点。
analysis.exam_tip: 记三个动作：看证据、讲理由、必要时修正。

audio.transcript: I will show you how I compared the two reports, but I will not choose your conclusion for you. Look at the evidence, explain your reasoning, and be prepared to revise your view if another explanation fits better.

card_records.back_text: 示范比较与推理的方法，让学习者根据证据形成并修正自己的判断。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：员工代表如何看待新系统？
front.support: 听录音：员工代表如何看待新系统？
front.context: 听录音：员工代表如何看待新系统？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 员工代表同意旧排班系统需要更换，也期待减少重复预约。但 remain concerned 表明他们担心过渡期间的培训与支持，希望每位使用者都能顺利适应。
analysis.exam_tip: 分别记“支持换系统”和“担心培训支持”。

audio.transcript: The staff representatives accept that the old scheduling system needs to be replaced. They are encouraged by the prospect of fewer duplicated bookings, but they remain concerned about training and support during the changeover. Their position is not opposition to the new technology itself; they want the transition to be manageable for everyone using it.

card_records.back_text: 接受更换系统，也期待收益，但担心培训与过渡支持。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：说话人对试点结果持什么态度？
front.support: 听录音：说话人对试点结果持什么态度？
front.context: 听录音：说话人对试点结果持什么态度？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: promising 肯定早期结果，尤其等候时间减少。但说话人想先听使用困难者的反馈，再判断是否完全成功，因为平均改善可能掩盖部分人的问题。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 before 后还需要了解哪类用户。

audio.transcript: The early results are promising, particularly the reduction in waiting time. Nevertheless, I would hesitate to call the trial a complete success before we hear from users who found the system difficult. The average improvement is useful information, but it may conceal problems affecting a smaller group of participants.

card_records.back_text: 谨慎肯定，认为还需关注使用困难者，暂不能称完全成功。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：说话人对每日安排的看法发生了什么变化？
front.support: 听录音：说话人对每日安排的看法发生了什么变化？
front.context: 听录音：说话人对每日安排的看法发生了什么变化？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: used to、began to question、now标记态度变化。说话人没有主张不做计划，而是改变了评价效率的标准。
analysis.exam_tip: 留意过去观点、转折经历和当前判断的时间标记。

audio.transcript: I used to believe that a full timetable was a sign of being productive. After several weeks of missing important deadlines, I began to question that assumption. Now I try to leave time between major tasks, and I judge a day by what I finish rather than by how crowded the calendar looks.

card_records.back_text: 从把忙碌当作高效，转为重视任务完成和安排余地。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：说话人是否认为整个方案毫无价值？
front.support: 听录音：说话人是否认为整个方案毫无价值？
front.context: 听录音：说话人是否认为整个方案毫无价值？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 说话人认可方案背后的努力，但当前方案没交代网络受限的学生如何参加，因此不能支持。若补上合适的替代方式，方案仍可能有用。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 in its present form，反对的是当前方案缺少什么。

audio.transcript: I appreciate the effort behind the proposal, but the current version does not explain how students with limited internet access would participate. That omission needs to be addressed before implementation. With a suitable alternative for those students, the scheme could still be useful; in its present form, however, I cannot support it.

card_records.back_text: 不是全盘否定；当前因缺少替代参与方式而不支持，补足后仍可能有价值。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：说话人对根据传闻评价他人的做法有什么态度？
front.support: 听录音：说话人对根据传闻评价他人的做法有什么态度？
front.context: 听录音：说话人对根据传闻评价他人的做法有什么态度？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: It worries me 明确表达担忧：传闻被重复后，很快变成人们对某人的定论。说话人主张先核实发生了什么，再给当事人解释机会。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 should check 和 give...an opportunity 两项建议。

audio.transcript: It worries me how quickly a rumour can become a settled opinion about someone. Repeating a claim does not make it more reliable. Before judging a colleague, we should check what actually happened and give that person an opportunity to explain, especially when the original story is incomplete.

card_records.back_text: 持批评和担忧态度，主张核实事实并听取本人说明。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：说话人对接下来的合作有什么预期？
front.support: 听录音：说话人对接下来的合作有什么预期？
front.context: 听录音：说话人对接下来的合作有什么预期？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: cautiously optimistic 是谨慎乐观，因为最新会议更有建设性，双方同意交换数据。provided that 要求承诺接下来落实为行动，不能又停留在泛泛表态。
analysis.exam_tip: 把 cautiously optimistic 与后面的行动条件一起听。

audio.transcript: We have not resolved every disagreement, but the latest meeting was more constructive than the earlier ones. Both teams identified areas where they could work together and agreed to exchange data. I am cautiously optimistic, provided that those promises are followed by practical action rather than another round of general statements.

card_records.back_text: 有条件地乐观，前提是承诺转化为实际行动。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 播放录音后，员工接受与怀疑的分别是什么？
front.support: 播放录音后，员工接受与怀疑的分别是什么？
front.context: 播放录音后，员工接受与怀疑的分别是什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 员工接受换旧设备，但 remain doubtful about 指向培训承诺。没有公布时间表和预算，让他们怀疑过渡期间能否获得支持。
analysis.exam_tip: 把 doubtful 的对象锁定为 promised training。

audio.transcript: The staff accept that the old equipment needs replacing. However, they remain doubtful about the promised training, because no timetable or budget has been announced. Their concern is about support during the change, not about keeping every old machine.

card_records.back_text: 接受更换设备的需要，但怀疑培训承诺是否会落实。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 播放录音后，顾问的支持附带什么条件？
front.support: 播放录音后，顾问的支持附带什么条件？
front.context: 播放录音后，顾问的支持附带什么条件？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 顾问欢迎弹性工时，但要先试行、再决定是否永久改变。试行须同时评估员工满意度和客户能否获得稳定、可预期的服务。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 both 回指的两项评估内容。

audio.transcript: The consultant welcomes flexible working hours but says they should be evaluated carefully. Staff satisfaction matters, she argues, yet customers also need predictable service. She would support a trial that measures both before a permanent change is made.

card_records.back_text: 支持试行弹性工时，并同时评估员工满意度和服务稳定性。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 播放录音后，报告为什么不只用“灵活”概括这类工作？
front.support: 播放录音后，报告为什么不只用“灵活”概括这类工作？
front.context: 播放录音后，报告为什么不只用“灵活”概括这类工作？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 有些工人喜欢自由选择任务，另一些担心收入每月波动太大。报告保留两种体验，因此只说“灵活”不足以概括这种工作。
analysis.exam_tip: 用 Some...Others... 区分两类体验。

audio.transcript: Some workers welcome the freedom to choose individual assignments. Others worry that their income changes too sharply from month to month. The report presents both views and argues that flexibility alone does not describe the full experience of this type of work.

card_records.back_text: 因为选择任务的自由与收入波动的担忧都存在。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 播放录音后，为什么不能把工会态度概括为完全赞同？
front.support: 播放录音后，为什么不能把工会态度概括为完全赞同？
front.context: 播放录音后，为什么不能把工会态度概括为完全赞同？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 工会原先支持现代化的条件是受影响工人获得合适培训。现在公司对培训交代太少，所以不能把对投资的支持理解为已认可整个转型安排。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 provided that 后的条件，再核对现在缺少什么。

audio.transcript: The union supported the plan to modernise the factory, provided that displaced workers received suitable training. It now says the company has offered too little detail about that training. Support for the investment therefore should not be mistaken for approval of every part of the transition.

card_records.back_text: 其支持以适当培训为条件，目前又认为培训细节不足。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 播放录音后，经济学家的判断有什么适用前提？
front.support: 播放录音后，经济学家的判断有什么适用前提？
front.context: 播放录音后，经济学家的判断有什么适用前提？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 经济学家认为有限价差可能促使供应商改进服务，前提是客户有真实替代选择。若一家控制整个市场，客户无处可选，这套解释就可能不成立。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 real alternatives，再对照 one supplier 的情形。

audio.transcript: The economist thinks a limited price difference can encourage suppliers to improve their services. However, she warns that customers must have real alternatives. If one supplier controls the entire market, the same argument may no longer apply.

card_records.back_text: 客户应有真实的替代选择，而非单一供应商控制全部市场。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 播放录音后，支持者与批评者各关注什么？
front.support: 播放录音后，支持者与批评者各关注什么？
front.context: 播放录音后，支持者与批评者各关注什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 支持者认为稳定的基本收入让工人更有底气拒绝恶劣工作条件。批评者质疑资金方案是否现实；说话人是在介绍两方分歧，未宣布谁已解决问题。
analysis.exam_tip: 分别记 supporters 的预期好处和 critics 的资金疑问。

audio.transcript: Supporters of the proposal believe a predictable basic payment would give workers more freedom to reject poor conditions. Critics question whether the funding plan is realistic. The speaker explains this disagreement without announcing that either side has settled the issue.

card_records.back_text: 支持者强调经济保障带来的选择空间；批评者质疑资金方案。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：为什么重复预约减少后，设备使用更顺畅？
front.support: 听录音：为什么重复预约减少后，设备使用更顺畅？
front.context: 听录音：为什么重复预约减少后，设备使用更顺畅？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 系统把每次预约连到已验证的小组账号，避免同一小组用不同名字重复预约。冲突少了，工作人员处理冲突的时间减少，学生就能更接近预定时间开始。
analysis.exam_tip: 顺着“账号绑定 → 重复少 → 冲突少 → 更准时”听。

audio.transcript: Previously, several groups sometimes reserved the same machine under different names. The new system links each reservation to a verified group account, preventing those duplicates. As a result, staff spend less time resolving booking conflicts, and students can begin their sessions closer to the planned starting time.

card_records.back_text: 验证小组账号防止重复预约，减少工作人员处理冲突的时间。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：说话人把报告延误归因于什么？
front.support: 听录音：说话人把报告延误归因于什么？
front.context: 听录音：说话人把报告延误归因于什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 报告在网络故障前已经发出，迟到的原因是收件地址写错，邮件直到第二天早上才转发。网络故障与延误同日发生，并不等于前者导致后者。
analysis.exam_tip: 先核对 sent before，再听 because 后的地址错误。

audio.transcript: The report arrived late on the same day that the office network failed. However, the author had completed and sent it before the failure. The delay occurred because the recipient's address had been entered incorrectly, and the message was not redirected until the next morning.

card_records.back_text: 收件地址填写错误，邮件到第二天才被转发。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 推理判断
front.prompt: 听录音：为什么新规定最初增加了处理时间？
front.support: 听录音：为什么新规定最初增加了处理时间？
front.context: 听录音：为什么新规定最初增加了处理时间？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 额外检查本来为了减少错误，但没有说明何时需要做。员工几乎对所有申请都加查，连简单情况也查，直到办公室明确适用范围后才不再这样处理。

front.support: 听录音：说话人用不同说法反复强调什么？
front.context: 听录音：说话人用不同说法反复强调什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: know what to expect、consistency、behaves as promised 都在说服务可靠、表现可预期。用户要靠它安排事情，重点是稳定兑现承诺，而非每次速度最快。
analysis.exam_tip: 找出三种说法共同强调的“可预期”。

audio.transcript: A reliable service does not have to be the fastest on every occasion, but people need to know what to expect. Let me put that another way: consistency matters because users plan around it. Again, the central issue is whether the service behaves as promised often enough for people to depend on it.

card_records.back_text: 可靠服务需要保持可预期的一致性，而不只是偶尔最快。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 主旨大意
front.prompt: 听录音：两次研究共同出现的结果是什么？
front.support: 听录音：两次研究共同出现的结果是什么？
front.context: 听录音：两次研究共同出现的结果是什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 两次研究都发现，清楚的例子帮助参与者少漏填信息。same pattern 和 consistent finding 都指 fewer omissions；更快或更满意没有在两次研究中同时测量。
analysis.exam_tip: 把 repeated finding 对应到 omissions。

audio.transcript: In the first study, clear examples helped participants complete unfamiliar forms with fewer omissions. A second study found the same pattern in a different group. The researchers repeated that the consistent finding concerned missing information, not faster completion or higher satisfaction, which were not measured in both studies.

card_records.back_text: 清晰示例与填写时遗漏更少这一结果在两次研究中都出现。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 主旨大意
front.prompt: 听录音：讲者反复对照“离目标多远”和“已经进步多少”，想提醒什么？
front.support: 听录音：讲者反复对照“离目标多远”和“已经进步多少”，想提醒什么？
front.context: 听录音：讲者反复对照“离目标多远”和“已经进步多少”，想提醒什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: how far remains 是离目标还差多少，how far we have come 是已经进步多少。讲者要求评价努力时兼顾 gains 和 gaps，既看进步也看差距。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 as well as：两方面都要看。

audio.transcript: If we look only at the distance to an ambitious goal, progress can be easy to overlook. We keep asking how far remains, instead of noticing how far we have come. I am not arguing against goals; I am asking us to measure gains as well as gaps when judging the value of our effort.

card_records.back_text: 评价努力时也要看已取得的进步，而不是只看与目标的差距。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 主旨大意
front.prompt: 听录音：三个服务例子反复说明哪一点？
front.support: 听录音：三个服务例子反复说明哪一点？
front.context: 听录音：三个服务例子反复说明哪一点？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 预约页在小屏难用、咨询台与上课时间冲突、指南术语陌生，都是“有服务却不方便用”的例子。共同观点是要让人真正能使用服务。
analysis.exam_tip: 把三个例子分别对应屏幕、时间和语言障碍。

audio.transcript: A booking page may be technically available but impossible to use on a small screen. A help desk may be open only when students are in class. A guide may contain the answer but use unfamiliar terms. These examples make the same point: providing a service is not the same as making it genuinely accessible.

card_records.back_text: 服务存在不等于人们能够实际方便地使用它。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 主旨大意
front.prompt: 听录音：讲者认为预算讨论中应反复回到哪一问题？
front.support: 听录音：讲者认为预算讨论中应反复回到哪一问题？
front.context: 听录音：讲者认为预算讨论中应反复回到哪一问题？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 讲者反复问 what problem must the equipment solve，设备要解决什么问题。便宜、品牌或功能多都不能替代“是否适合实际任务”这个购买标准。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 return to the same question 后重复的问题。

audio.transcript: We can compare prices, brands, and optional features for hours. But I want to return to the same question: what problem must the equipment solve? Unless we answer that, a cheaper purchase may still be a waste. The priority, as I have stressed throughout, is fitness for the actual task.

card_records.back_text: 设备是否适合实际任务、能否解决真正的问题。

front.prompt: 听录音：讲者重复强调学习工具有效所需的什么条件？
front.support: 听录音：讲者重复强调学习工具有效所需的什么条件？
front.context: 听录音：讲者重复强调学习工具有效所需的什么条件？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: provided that 的条件是学生批判性地检查工具建议。I repeat 再强调：自己判断后使用，工具才可能帮助学习；照单全收可能把误解藏起来。
analysis.exam_tip: 把 useful suggestions 与 examine them critically 一起概括。

audio.transcript: The tool can offer useful suggestions, provided that students examine them critically. I repeat that condition because accepting every suggestion automatically would defeat the purpose. Used with careful judgement, the tool may support learning; used as a substitute for judgement, it may simply hide misunderstandings.

card_records.back_text: 学生必须批判性地检查建议，用工具辅助而不替代自己的判断。

front.prompt: 播放录音后，讲者反复强调什么，同时提醒什么限制？
front.support: 播放录音后，讲者反复强调什么，同时提醒什么限制？
front.context: 播放录音后，讲者反复强调什么，同时提醒什么限制？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 三项调查都发现，觉得活动有意义的人往往更满意。讲者再次强调这种模式，同时说单凭调查无法确定是意义感带来满意，还是反过来。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 which factor caused the other，注意因果方向未确定。

audio.transcript: Across the three surveys, people who felt their activities were meaningful tended to report greater satisfaction. I want to stress that pattern again, while also reminding you that the surveys alone cannot establish which factor caused the other.

card_records.back_text: 意义感与满意度常一起出现；调查本身不能确定因果方向。

front.prompt: 播放录音后，反复重申的发现能否推广到所有人群？
front.support: 播放录音后，反复重申的发现能否推广到所有人群？
front.context: 播放录音后，反复重申的发现能否推广到所有人群？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 这种关联在受测的每个年龄组中都出现，但所有样本只来自一个地区。each age group 指研究中的年龄组，不是已经调查所有地区的所有人群。
analysis.exam_tip: 给 each age group 加回 we studied 的范围。

audio.transcript: Let me repeat the central finding: the association appeared in each of the age groups we studied. That does not mean we tested every population. The sample came from one region, and further work is needed before drawing wider conclusions.

card_records.back_text: 不能。它出现在受测年龄组中，但样本只来自一个地区。

front.prompt: 播放录音后，三项研究是否完全一致？综合判断是什么？
front.support: 播放录音后，三项研究是否完全一致？综合判断是什么？
front.context: 播放录音后，三项研究是否完全一致？综合判断是什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 前两项调查发现相似关联，第三项采用不同测量，结论更谨慎。综合来看，这个关系值得继续研究，但问题尚未解决。
analysis.exam_tip: 按 first、second、third 比较三项结果。

audio.transcript: The first survey found an association, and the second found a similar pattern in another group. The third used a different measure and reached a more cautious conclusion. Taken together, they suggest a relationship worth investigating, rather than a question that is fully settled.

card_records.back_text: 不完全一致，第三项更谨慎；整体提示值得继续调查的关系。

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 主旨大意
front.prompt: 播放录音后，讲者为什么重复发现，又提醒不能混淆什么？
front.support: 播放录音后，讲者为什么重复发现，又提醒不能混淆什么？
front.context: 播放录音后，讲者为什么重复发现，又提醒不能混淆什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 讲者反复提同一发现，是为了串联例子。重复说本身不增加证据；研究是否设计合理、能否被其他研究者独立检验，才决定它有多可信。
analysis.exam_tip: 分开听重复的讲述作用和证据的来源。

audio.transcript: I have returned to the same finding several times because it helps connect the examples. But repetition itself is not extra evidence. What matters is whether the studies were well designed and whether other researchers can test the result independently.

card_records.back_text: 用同一发现串联例子，同时提醒重复次数不等于新增证据。

front.prompt: 播放录音后，全篇反复出现的核心区别是什么？
front.support: 播放录音后，全篇反复出现的核心区别是什么？
front.context: 播放录音后，全篇反复出现的核心区别是什么？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 一天做多少活动，比不上投入质量和选择这些活动的原因更能说明体验。同样忙的日程，会因参与的理由不同而感觉很不一样。
analysis.exam_tip: 对照 number of activities 与 quality of involvement。

audio.transcript: I want to return to the distinction that has guided this talk. The number of activities in a day tells us less than the quality of our involvement in them. The same busy schedule can feel very different depending on why we chose those activities.

card_records.back_text: 活动数量与投入质量的区别，以及活动选择理由的重要性。

front.prompt: 播放录音后，最后如何同时概括共同模式与差异？
front.support: 播放录音后，最后如何同时概括共同模式与差异？
front.context: 播放录音后，最后如何同时概括共同模式与差异？

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 多个群体都观察到关联，是共同模式；关联强度又随情境和测量方法而变。结论同时保留“会重复出现”和“并非处处一样”。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 observed 的共同发现，再听 varied 的差别。

audio.transcript: Overall, the association was observed in several groups, but its strength varied with the setting and the way it was measured. That is the conclusion I want to leave with you: a recurring pattern can be useful without being identical everywhere.

card_records.back_text: 多个群体出现类似关联，但强度随情境和测量方式变化，并非处处相同。

Professor Linda Hart from Cambridge University analyzed 18 longitudinal studies published between 2008 and 2020. She found that participants who slept fewer than six hours were 1.8 times as likely to report attention problems.

front.context: 划去不能由材料支持的判断，保留有依据的判断。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 18项研究不是eight，2008—2020不是2010—2022，应划去2、4。1保留研究者与机构，3保留睡眠少于六小时者报告注意力问题的相对可能性。1.8 times as likely不是“增加了1.8倍”。
analysis.exam_tip: 倍数先判断是“为原来的几倍”还是“增加了几倍”，同时保留测量的结果。

elimination_items.text: The researcher was Linda Hart from Cambridge University.
She analyzed eight longitudinal studies.
Participants sleeping fewer than six hours were 1.8 times as likely to report attention problems.
The studies were published between 2010 and 2022.

analysis.summary: mis- 表示错误，并不专指低价或故意压价。can trigger 表示可能引发连锁损失，不是宣布没有影响，也不是说损失必然发生。
analysis.exam_tip: 每项判断都要有材料依据，不能只匹配相同词语。

elimination_items.text: mispricing means assigning an incorrect price to the risk.
mispricing means deliberately setting every price below its proper level.
The warning says that incorrect pricing cannot affect losses.
The passage connects incorrect risk pricing with possible cascading losses.

front.eyebrow: 这张练习 | 上下文猜词
front.prompt:
练习材料（虚构情境）
The summary understated the damage: the affected area was nearly twice the figure it gave.

判断：understated 在这里指报告的损害程度低于实际情况，不是“在下面陈述”。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: under-在understate中表示说得不足，nearly twice the figure提供直接验证。它不是地点“在下面”，也不表示作者夸大了损害。
analysis.exam_tip: 把under-的程度义与数字比较结合，不把所有under都当空间位置。
